title: Mediterranean Chicken, Tomato, and Chickpea Skillet
intro: Simmering bite-sized chicken thighs with crushed tomatoes and chickpeas creates a hearty stew in a single pan. Serve this simple, comforting meal with warm whole-wheat pitas for dipping.

ingredients.name: Boneless, skinless chicken thighs
ingredients.canonical_name: Chicken, broilers or fryers, thigh, meat only, raw

ingredients.name: Zucchini
ingredients.canonical_name: Squash, summer, zucchini, includes skin, raw

ingredients.name: No-salt-added canned diced tomatoes
ingredients.canonical_name: Tomatoes, red, ripe, canned, packed in tomato juice, no salt added

ingredients.name: No-salt-added canned chickpeas
ingredients.canonical_name: Chickpeas (garbanzo beans), mature seeds, canned, without salt

instructions: Heat the extra-virgin olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering.
Add the chicken pieces and cook for 4 to 5 minutes until lightly browned on all sides.
Stir in the zucchini, garlic powder, and dried oregano, and cook for 2 to 3 minutes until the zucchini begins to soften.
Pour in the diced tomatoes and chickpeas, stir well to combine, and bring to a rolling simmer.
Reduce the heat to medium-low, cover the skillet, and simmer for 8 to 10 minutes until the chicken is cooked through.
Remove the skillet from the heat, then stir in the kalamata olives and fresh lemon juice.
Serve the warm stew in bowls accompanied by the whole-wheat pitas.
variation: Swap the zucchini for diced eggplant and simmer until tender.
conservation: Keeps 3-4 days refrigerated; reheat in a skillet over low heat.
